latestPosts.title: llm-d 1.0: Keep Agent Traffic Moving
latestPosts.author: The ByteLand Team
latestPosts.description: Separate queues, reuse prompt context, and coordinate serving pools. A practical guide to the operating choices in llm-d 1.0.

latestPosts.title: Transformers 5.20.2: Keep the Object When You Move the Tensor
latestPosts.author: The ByteLand Team
latestPosts.description: A device-transfer helper kept tensor data but erased ModelOutput behavior. We reproduce the failure and the fix with tiny BART and LLaVA models on CPU.

latestPosts.title: LangGraph 1.2.16: Resume an Agent Without Repeating Finished Work
latestPosts.author: The ByteLand Team
latestPosts.description: A correct final state can hide repeated actions. We compare LangGraph 1.2.15 and 1.2.16 on real resume regressions, then check what the patch does not guarantee.
